svg.title: The unsound mode against the other heuristics
svg.desc: For each of two stretches of games, the share of games at the reference score against the mean seconds a game, a point for each heuristic strategy and for each level of effort of the unsound mode.
svg.text: The share of games at the reference score against the time of 100 games on the machine
88 CPUs: independent games 88 at a time, a chain one game after another; the unsound mode on 64 threads (converted).
A hollow mark takes its share and its seconds from some of the games only (the note under each panel).
